mapper.insert: insert into merchant (merchant_name, region, description, user_id) values (#{merchantName}, #{region}, #{description}, #{user_id})
mapper.select: select id from merchant where user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT region FROM merchant ORDER BY region ASC
SELECT m.id, m.merchant_name, m.region, m.description, m.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.merchant_id = m.id AND p.status = 1) AS product_count FROM merchant m WHERE m.id = #{id}
